tool.name: academy_dailyrecord_get
tool.title: Read live DailyRecord by student name (today by default)
tool.description: Read live DailyRecord by exact student name. Preferred for requests such as “오늘 학생 DailyRecord 조회해봐” or current/today DailyRecord lookups. Omit lessonDate for today in Asia/Seoul. The owner launch supplies namespace, teacher and admitted dates; this tool resolves the name to a native key then calls academy_dailyrecord_intake. Never use saved academy_query or academy_source_status to decide live availability. Ambiguous names, missing admission, out-of-range dates or failed source reads stop with a named blocker; no guesses or automatic retry. Returns observed fields even when authoring would require a memo/assessment interview. No authoring, save or send.

displayName.description: Exact student display name from the current user request; never guess a native key.

purpose.description: The current user request or its purpose. Reading does not authorize authoring or saving.

currentRequestRef.description: Reference to this current user request; not an approval or credential.

lessonDate.description: Omit for today in Asia/Seoul. An explicit date must fall inside the owner-admitted range.
